note: Contenido ORIGINAL (no traducido) para enseñar español a angloparlantes. question/options/answer en español (idioma meta); explanation en inglés (idioma nativo del estudiante) — simetría inversa al pack es-en. Ver content-packs/en-es/PENDING.md.

exercises.question: _____, ¿cómo estás?
exercises.explanation: 'Hola' means 'hello' — the standard greeting in Spanish.

exercises.question: Buenos _____ (said before noon).
exercises.explanation: 'Buenos días' means 'good morning' — used until around midday.

exercises.question: Buenas _____ (said in the afternoon).
exercises.explanation: 'Tardes' is feminine plural, so it pairs with 'buenas', not 'buenos'.

exercises.question: Mucho _____ (nice to meet you).
exercises.explanation: 'Mucho gusto' literally means 'much pleasure' — how you say 'nice to meet you'.

exercises.question: _____ luego (see you later).
exercises.explanation: 'Hasta luego' means 'see you later' — 'hasta' means 'until'.

exercises.question: Por _____ (please).
exercises.explanation: 'Por favor' is the standard way to say 'please'.

exercises.question: De _____ (you're welcome).
exercises.explanation: 'De nada' literally means 'of nothing' — the standard reply to 'gracias'.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo te _____? (What's your name?)
exercises.explanation: '¿Cómo te llamas?' uses the informal 'tú' form of llamarse.

exercises.question: Me _____ Ana. (My name is Ana.)
exercises.explanation: 'Me llamo' literally means 'I call myself' — the first-person form of llamarse.

exercises.question: Buenas _____ (good night, greeting or farewell).
exercises.explanation: 'Noches' is feminine plural, so it pairs with 'buenas'.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'one' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Uno' is the number 1 in Spanish.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'five' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Cinco' is the number 5.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'ten' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Diez' is the number 10.

exercises.question: Tres + tres = _____.
exercises.explanation: 3+3=6, and 'seis' is six.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'fifteen' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Quince' is fifteen — a well-known number (as in 'quinceañera').

exercises.question: Después de nueve viene _____.
exercises.explanation: The number after nueve (nine) is diez (ten).

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'twenty' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Veinte' is twenty.

exercises.question: Dos + dos = _____.
exercises.explanation: 2+2=4, and 'cuatro' is four.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'eight' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Ocho' is eight.

exercises.question: Antes de siete viene _____.
exercises.explanation: The number before siete (seven) is seis (six).

exercises.question: ¿Qué letra no existe en el alfabeto inglés?
exercises.explanation: 'Ñ' is unique to Spanish (and a few other languages) — pronounced like the 'ny' in 'canyon'.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se pronuncia la letra 'h' en español?
exercises.explanation: The Spanish 'h' is always silent — 'hola' sounds like 'ola'.

exercises.question: La palabra 'año' se pronuncia con un sonido parecido al de...
exercises.explanation: 'Ñ' makes an 'ny' sound, like in the English word 'canyon'.

exercises.question: ¿Cuál de estas letras SÍ lleva tilde en español?
exercises.explanation: Spanish uses accent marks (tildes) on vowels to show stress — á, é, í, ó, ú.

exercises.question: La 'j' en español suena parecido a la 'h' inglesa en la palabra...
exercises.explanation: Spanish 'j' has a breathy sound like the English 'h' in 'hello', not like the English 'j'.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se llama el signo '¿' que abre las preguntas en español?
exercises.explanation: Spanish questions open with an inverted question mark '¿' and close with a normal '?'.

exercises.question: La palabra 'pequeño' contiene la letra...
exercises.explanation: 'Pequeño' (small) contains the ñ.

exercises.question: ¿Cuántas vocales tiene el español?
exercises.explanation: Spanish has exactly 5 vowels: a, e, i, o, u — each with one consistent sound, unlike English.

exercises.question: En la mayoría de Latinoamérica, la 'll' suena parecido a la...
exercises.explanation: In most of Latin America, 'll' sounds like the English 'y' (as in 'yes').

exercises.question: ¿Cuál palabra está bien escrita?
exercises.explanation: 'Rápido' (fast) needs the accent mark on the 'a' to show where the stress falls.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'Monday' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Lunes' is Monday. In Spanish-speaking countries the week often starts on Monday, not Sunday.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'Sunday' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Domingo' is Sunday.

exercises.question: El día después de 'lunes' es _____.
exercises.explanation: The day after Monday (lunes) is Tuesday (martes).

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'January' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Enero' is January. Spanish months aren't capitalized like in English.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'December' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Diciembre' is December.

exercises.question: El mes antes de 'mayo' es _____.
exercises.explanation: The month before mayo (May) is abril (April).

exercises.question: ¿Cuántos días tiene una semana?
exercises.explanation: A week (semana) has siete (seven) days.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'weekend' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Fin de semana' literally means 'end of week' — that's how Spanish says 'weekend'.

exercises.question: En el calendario hispano, el último día de la semana suele ser _____.
exercises.explanation: Since the Spanish-speaking week starts on Monday, it ends on domingo (Sunday).

exercises.question: ¿Cómo se dice 'July' en español?
exercises.explanation: 'Julio' is July.

exercises.question: Yo _____ estudiante.
exercises.explanation: Use 'ser' for identity and profession (a permanent characteristic) — 'soy' is the yo-form.

exercises.question: Ella _____ cansada hoy.
exercises.explanation: Use 'estar' for temporary states or feelings — 'está' is the third-person form.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ de Argentina.
exercises.explanation: Use 'ser' for origin and nationality — 'somos' is the nosotros-form.

exercises.question: El café _____ caliente ahora mismo.
exercises.explanation: The current temperature or condition of something uses 'estar'.

exercises.question: Tú _____ muy inteligente.
exercises.explanation: Permanent personality traits use 'ser' — 'eres' is the tú-form.

exercises.question: ¿Dónde _____ el baño?
exercises.explanation: The location of a fixed object or place always uses 'estar', even though it feels permanent — a classic exception worth memorizing.

exercises.question: Hoy _____ lunes.
exercises.explanation: Days of the week and dates use 'ser' — 'es lunes' (it's Monday).

exercises.question: Mi hermano _____ médico.
exercises.explanation: Professions use 'ser', not 'estar'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ en la escuela ahora.
exercises.explanation: 'Estoy' (from estar) is used to describe your current location.

exercises.question: La fiesta _____ en mi casa.
exercises.explanation: Tricky exception: the location of an EVENT (not a physical object) uses 'ser' — 'la fiesta es en mi casa'.

exercises.question: Mi _____ es la hermana de mi mamá.
exercises.explanation: 'Tía' means 'aunt' — your mother's or father's sister.

exercises.question: Mi padre y mi madre son mis _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Padres' means 'parents' (father and mother together).

exercises.question: El hijo de mi tío es mi _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Primo' means 'cousin' (male).

exercises.question: La madre de mi padre es mi _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Abuela' means 'grandmother'.

exercises.question: Mi hermano y yo somos los _____ de nuestros padres.
exercises.explanation: 'Hijos' means 'children/sons' — the offspring of the parents.

exercises.question: El esposo de mi hermana es mi _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Cuñado' means 'brother-in-law'.

exercises.question: Los padres de mi esposo son mis _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Suegros' means 'in-laws' (your spouse's parents).

exercises.question: Mi hermana tiene un bebé; yo soy su _____.
exercises.explanation: You become an aunt ('tía') when your sibling has a child.

exercises.question: Mi padre se casó de nuevo. Su nueva esposa es mi _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Madrastra' means 'stepmother'.

exercises.question: Vivo con mis padres y mi hermano; somos una familia de _____ personas.
exercises.explanation: Counting practice in a family context — 'cuatro' means 'four'.

exercises.question: Mi padre trabaja en un hospital. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Médico' means 'doctor'.

exercises.question: Ella enseña matemáticas en la escuela. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Maestra' means 'teacher' (female).

exercises.question: Él cocina en un restaurante. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Cocinero' means 'cook/chef'.

exercises.question: Mi tía defiende a la gente en la corte. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Abogada' means 'lawyer' (female).

exercises.question: Él repara los cables eléctricos de la casa. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Electricista' means 'electrician' — same word for men and women.

exercises.question: Ella maneja un taxi. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Taxista' means 'taxi driver' — same word for men and women.

exercises.question: Mi hermano cuida a los pacientes en el hospital, pero no es doctor. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Enfermero' means 'nurse' (male).

exercises.question: Ella vuela aviones. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Piloto' means 'pilot' — the same word is used for men and women.

exercises.question: Él vende pan en la panadería. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Panadero' means 'baker'.

exercises.question: ¿A qué te _____? (What's your job?)
exercises.explanation: '¿A qué te dedicas?' is a common way to ask 'what do you do for a living?'.

exercises.question: Ella es de España. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: Nationality adjectives agree in gender — 'española' (feminine) for a woman from Spain.

exercises.question: Él es de México. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Mexicano' is the masculine form for a man from Mexico.

exercises.question: Nosotros somos de Argentina. Somos _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Argentinos' is the masculine/mixed plural, used for a group with at least one man.

exercises.question: Ellas son de Francia. Son _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Francesas' is feminine plural, for a group of women from France.

exercises.question: ¿De dónde _____ tú?
exercises.explanation: '¿De dónde eres?' uses the 'tú' form of ser to ask where someone is from.

exercises.question: Yo soy de Estados Unidos. Soy _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Estadounidense' is the standard word for 'American' (from the US) and doesn't change for gender.

exercises.question: Él es de Brasil. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Brasileño' means 'Brazilian' (masculine).

exercises.question: Ellos son de Alemania. Son _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Alemanes' is the masculine/mixed plural for 'German'.

exercises.question: Ella es de Italia. Es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Italiana' is the feminine form for 'Italian'.

exercises.question: ¿Cuál es tu _____? (nationality)
exercises.explanation: 'Nacionalidad' means 'nationality'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú estudiante?
exercises.explanation: Question form of 'ser' with 'tú' is '¿Eres...?'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ ella doctora?
exercises.explanation: Third person singular of 'ser' is 'es'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ ustedes de Chile?
exercises.explanation: 'Son' is used with 'ustedes' (formal/plural you).

exercises.question: ¿Quién _____ tu profesor?
exercises.explanation: '¿Quién es...?' asks 'who is...?' with the third-person form 'es'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ nosotros los últimos?
exercises.explanation: 'Somos' is the 'nosotros' (we) form of ser.

exercises.question: ¿De dónde _____ ellos?
exercises.explanation: Third person plural 'son' is used for 'ellos' (they).

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú y tu hermano gemelos?
exercises.explanation: When asking about 'tú y tu hermano' together, Spanish uses the third-person plural 'son'.

exercises.question: ¿Cómo _____ tu casa?
exercises.explanation: Asking someone to describe something uses 'es' (it is).

exercises.question: ¿_____ usted el señor García?
exercises.explanation: 'Usted' (formal you) takes the third-person form 'es'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ yo el primero en llegar?
exercises.explanation: 'Soy' is the first-person singular form of ser, used for 'I am'.

exercises.question: _____ casa es grande. (My house)
exercises.explanation: 'Mi' means 'my' — the same form for masculine and feminine singular nouns.

exercises.question: ¿Dónde está _____ mochila? (your backpack, informal)
exercises.explanation: 'Tu' means 'your' (informal singular) — no accent, unlike 'tú' (you).

exercises.question: _____ hijos van a la misma escuela. (our children)
exercises.explanation: 'Nuestros' agrees in gender and number with 'hijos' (masculine plural).

exercises.question: Ella perdió _____ llaves. (her keys)
exercises.explanation: 'Su' becomes 'sus' before a plural noun.

exercises.question: _____ profesor es muy simpático. (his/her teacher)
exercises.explanation: 'Su' means 'his/her/your(formal)/their' — the same word covers all of these, context clarifies which.

exercises.question: ¿Es ese _____ perro? (your dog, formal)
exercises.explanation: With 'usted' (formal), the possessive is 'su', not 'tu'.

exercises.question: _____ amigos viven en Lima. (my friends)
exercises.explanation: 'Mis' is the plural form of 'mi', used before plural nouns.

exercises.question: Nosotros amamos _____ país. (our country)
exercises.explanation: 'Nuestro' agrees with 'país' (masculine singular).

exercises.question: Ellos venden _____ carro viejo. (their old car)
exercises.explanation: 'Su' before a singular noun means 'their' here, agreeing with 'carro' (singular).

exercises.question: ¿Cuál es _____ número de teléfono? (your number, informal)
exercises.explanation: 'Tu' (no accent) is the possessive 'your' — don't confuse it with 'tú' (you, with accent).

exercises.question: El gato está _____ la mesa. (on top of)
exercises.explanation: 'Sobre' means 'on/on top of'.

exercises.question: El libro está _____ la mesa. (under)
exercises.explanation: 'Debajo de' means 'under/underneath'.

exercises.question: La tienda está _____ el banco. (next to)
exercises.explanation: 'Al lado de' means 'next to/beside'.

exercises.question: El parque está _____ mi casa. (far from)
exercises.explanation: 'Lejos de' means 'far from'.

exercises.question: La farmacia está _____ mi casa. (close to)
exercises.explanation: 'Cerca de' means 'close to/near'.

exercises.question: El coche está _____ la casa y el árbol. (between)
exercises.explanation: 'Entre' means 'between'.

exercises.question: Los niños están _____ del edificio. (in front of)
exercises.explanation: 'Delante de' means 'in front of' — here shortened before 'del'.

exercises.question: El perro está _____ la puerta. (behind)
exercises.explanation: 'Detrás de' means 'behind'.

exercises.question: Las llaves están _____ mi bolso. (inside)
exercises.explanation: 'Dentro de' means 'inside'.

exercises.question: El gato está _____ la casa, no adentro. (outside)
exercises.explanation: 'Fuera de' means 'outside of'.

exercises.question: _____ un libro en la mesa.
exercises.explanation: 'Hay' means 'there is/there are' — it doesn't change for singular or plural.

exercises.question: _____ tres estudiantes en la clase.
exercises.explanation: 'Hay' stays the same even with plural nouns — unlike 'es/son'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ un baño aquí?
exercises.explanation: Asking about existence uses '¿hay...?' (is there...?).

exercises.question: No _____ leche en la nevera.
exercises.explanation: 'No hay' means 'there isn't/there aren't'.

exercises.question: _____ muchas personas en la fiesta.
exercises.explanation: 'Hay' + plural noun means 'there are many...'.

exercises.question: ¿Cuántos libros _____ en la mochila?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cuántos... hay?' asks 'how many... are there?'.

exercises.question: _____ una fiesta en mi casa esta noche.
exercises.explanation: 'Hay' introduces something that exists — 'there is a party'.

exercises.question: En mi ciudad _____ dos hospitales.
exercises.explanation: 'Hay' remains invariable no matter what number follows.

exercises.question: _____ poco tiempo para terminar.
exercises.explanation: 'Hay poco tiempo' means 'there is little time'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ algo de comer?
exercises.explanation: '¿Hay algo de...?' asks 'is there any...?'.

exercises.question: Yo me _____ a las siete. (wake up)
exercises.explanation: 'Despertarse' — the yo-form is 'me despierto'.

exercises.question: Ella se _____ rápido por la mañana. (gets up)
exercises.explanation: 'Levantarse' — the third-person form is 'se levanta'.

exercises.question: Nosotros nos _____ antes de desayunar. (shower)
exercises.explanation: 'Ducharse' — the nosotros-form is 'nos duchamos'.

exercises.question: Tú te _____ muy elegante. (get dressed)
exercises.explanation: 'Vestirse' — the tú-form is 'te vistes'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ café todas las mañanas. (have breakfast)
exercises.explanation: 'Desayunar' is not reflexive — 'yo desayuno' means 'I have breakfast'.

exercises.question: Ellos se _____ tarde los fines de semana. (go to bed)
exercises.explanation: 'Acostarse' — the third-person plural form is 'se acuestan'.

exercises.question: ¿A qué hora te _____ tú? (wake up)
exercises.explanation: The question form uses 'te despiertas' with 'tú'.

exercises.question: Mi hermano se _____ los dientes después de comer. (brushes)
exercises.explanation: 'Cepillarse los dientes' — the third-person form is 'se cepilla'.

exercises.question: Nosotros nos _____ a las once de la noche. (go to bed)
exercises.explanation: 'Acostarse' — the nosotros-form is 'nos acostamos'.

exercises.question: Yo me _____ antes de salir de casa. (get dressed)
exercises.explanation: 'Vestirse' — the yo-form is 'me visto'.

exercises.question: ¿Qué hora _____?
exercises.explanation: '¿Qué hora es?' is the standard way to ask the time.

exercises.question: _____ la una de la tarde.
exercises.explanation: Use 'es' only for one o'clock ('la una').

exercises.question: _____ las tres de la tarde.
exercises.explanation: Use 'son' for every other hour (two o'clock and beyond).

exercises.question: El tren sale a las _____ y media. (nine-thirty)
exercises.explanation: 'A las nueve y media' means 'at nine-thirty'.

exercises.question: Son las diez _____ cuarto. (quarter past)
exercises.explanation: 'Y cuarto' means 'quarter past' the hour.

exercises.question: Son las ocho _____ cuarto. (quarter to)
exercises.explanation: 'Menos cuarto' means 'quarter to' the hour.

exercises.question: La reunión es _____ mediodía.
exercises.explanation: 'Al mediodía' (a + el) means 'at noon' — 'al' is the contraction of 'a' and 'el'.

exercises.question: Trabajo desde las nueve _____ las cinco.
exercises.explanation: 'Desde... hasta...' means 'from... until...'.

exercises.question: Son las doce de la noche, es _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Medianoche' means 'midnight'.

exercises.question: ¿A qué _____ empieza la clase?
exercises.explanation: '¿A qué hora...?' asks 'at what time...?'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ español todos los días. (study)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar verbs: the yo-form ends in -o — 'estudio'.

exercises.question: Tú _____ mucha agua. (drink)
exercises.explanation: Regular -er verbs: the tú-form ends in -es — 'bebes'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ en Madrid. (live)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ir verbs: the third-person form ends in -e — 'vive'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ la puerta cada noche. (close)
exercises.explanation: The nosotros-form of regular -ar verbs ends in -amos — 'cerramos'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ pizza los viernes. (eat)
exercises.explanation: -er verbs: the third-person plural ends in -en — 'comen'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ cartas a mis amigos. (write)
exercises.explanation: -ir verbs: the yo-form ends in -o — 'escribo'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú en la oficina? (work)
exercises.explanation: -ar verbs: the tú-form ends in -as — 'trabajas'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ en el mismo edificio. (live)
exercises.explanation: -ir verbs: the nosotros-form ends in -imos — 'vivimos'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ mucho café por la mañana. (drink)
exercises.explanation: -er verbs: the third-person singular ends in -e — 'bebe'.

exercises.question: Ustedes _____ inglés en la escuela. (study)
exercises.explanation: -ar verbs: the third-person plural ends in -an — 'estudian'.

exercises.question: _____ libro es interesante. (this, masculine)
exercises.explanation: 'Este' means 'this' (masculine, near the speaker).

exercises.question: _____ camisa es bonita. (this, feminine)
exercises.explanation: 'Esta' is the feminine form of 'this'.

exercises.question: _____ zapatos son caros. (those, near the listener)
exercises.explanation: 'Esos' means 'those' (masculine, near the listener).

exercises.question: _____ casa allá es de mis abuelos. (that, far away)
exercises.explanation: 'Aquella' means 'that' (feminine, far from both speaker and listener).

exercises.question: Me gusta _____ restaurante. (that one, near you)
exercises.explanation: 'Ese' means 'that' (masculine, near the listener).

exercises.question: _____ es mi hermano. (this one)
exercises.explanation: As a pronoun referring to a person, 'este' means 'this one'.

exercises.question: ¿Qué es _____? (that, unspecified object)
exercises.explanation: 'Eso' is the neuter form, used for unspecified or unknown things.

exercises.question: _____ flores son para ti. (these)
exercises.explanation: 'Estas' means 'these' (feminine plural).

exercises.question: No me gustan _____ zapatos, prefiero estos. (those, far)
exercises.explanation: 'Aquellos' means 'those' (far away, masculine plural).

exercises.question: _____ es mi comida favorita. (this, unspecified)
exercises.explanation: 'Esto' is the neuter form for 'this', used for unspecified things.

exercises.question: Yo _____ un perro.
exercises.explanation: 'Tener' is irregular in the yo-form: 'tengo'.

exercises.question: Tú _____ mucha suerte.
exercises.explanation: 'Tener' — the tú-form is 'tienes' (e→ie stem change).

exercises.question: Ella _____ veinte años.
exercises.explanation: 'Tener' — the third-person form is 'tiene'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ una reunión hoy.
exercises.explanation: 'Tenemos' is the nosotros-form — note it does NOT stem-change.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ dos coches.
exercises.explanation: 'Tener' — the third-person plural is 'tienen'.

exercises.question: ¿Cuántos años _____ tú?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cuántos años tienes?' is how you ask someone's age.

exercises.question: Yo _____ hambre.
exercises.explanation: 'Tener hambre' means 'to be hungry' — literally 'to have hunger'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ ustedes tiempo?
exercises.explanation: 'Ustedes' takes the third-person plural form 'tienen'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ frío.
exercises.explanation: 'Tener frío' means 'to be cold' — the nosotros-form is 'tenemos'.

exercises.question: Ella no _____ tiempo hoy.
exercises.explanation: Negation with 'no' just goes before the verb — no other change needed.

exercises.question: Yo _____ nadar muy bien.
exercises.explanation: 'Poder' — the yo-form is 'puedo' (o→ue stem change).

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú ayudarme?
exercises.explanation: 'Poder' — the tú-form is 'puedes'.

exercises.question: Él _____ hablar tres idiomas.
exercises.explanation: 'Poder' — the third-person form is 'puede'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ ir mañana.
exercises.explanation: 'Podemos' is the nosotros-form — it does NOT stem-change.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ venir a la fiesta.
exercises.explanation: 'Poder' — the third-person plural is 'pueden'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ usted repetir eso, por favor?
exercises.explanation: Formal 'usted' takes the third-person form 'puede'.

exercises.question: Yo no _____ dormir bien.
exercises.explanation: Negative sentences with 'no' keep the same conjugated form.

exercises.question: ¿Se _____ fumar aquí?
exercises.explanation: '¿Se puede...?' is a common way to ask if something is allowed.

exercises.question: Nosotros no _____ salir hoy.
exercises.explanation: 'Podemos' — the nosotros-form, unaffected by the stem change.

exercises.question: Ella _____ tocar el piano.
exercises.explanation: 'Poder' + infinitive expresses ability — 'ella puede tocar' (she can play).

exercises.question: Camine todo _____ hasta el semáforo. (straight)
exercises.explanation: 'Todo derecho' means 'straight ahead'.

exercises.question: Gire a la _____ en la esquina. (right)
exercises.explanation: 'A la derecha' means 'to the right'.

exercises.question: Gire a la _____ en la próxima calle. (left)
exercises.explanation: 'A la izquierda' means 'to the left'.

exercises.question: Tiene que _____ la calle para llegar. (cross)
exercises.explanation: 'Cruzar' means 'to cross'.

exercises.question: _____ recto dos cuadras más. (continue)
exercises.explanation: 'Siga recto' means 'continue/keep going straight'.

exercises.question: El museo está a dos _____ de aquí. (blocks)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuadras' means 'blocks' (used across most of Latin America).

exercises.question: ¿Cómo _____ a la estación de tren?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cómo llego a...?' is how you ask 'how do I get to...?'.

exercises.question: Está en la _____ de la calle Mayor. (corner)
exercises.explanation: 'Esquina' means 'corner'.

exercises.question: Perdón, ¿dónde _____ el baño?
exercises.explanation: The location of something uses 'estar' — 'está'.

exercises.question: Siga las _____ hasta la salida. (signs)
exercises.explanation: 'Señales' means 'signs'.

exercises.question: ¿Cuánto _____ esta camisa?
exercises.explanation: 'Cuesta' (singular) is used for one item — from the verb 'costar'.

exercises.question: ¿Cuánto _____ estos zapatos?
exercises.explanation: 'Cuestan' (plural) is used for more than one item.

exercises.question: El café _____ tres dólares.
exercises.explanation: 'Cuesta' agrees with a singular item — 'el café'.

exercises.question: Esta bolsa _____ muy cara.
exercises.explanation: Describing an inherent quality like price level uses 'ser' — 'es cara'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ algún descuento?
exercises.explanation: '¿Hay descuento?' asks 'is there a discount?'.

exercises.question: Las entradas _____ baratas hoy.
exercises.explanation: 'Estar barato/caro' describes a price as temporarily low (like a sale), unlike the inherent-quality use of 'ser'.

exercises.question: ¿Aceptan tarjeta de _____?
exercises.explanation: 'Tarjeta de crédito' means 'credit card'.

exercises.question: Voy a pagar en _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Efectivo' means 'cash'.

exercises.question: El total es _____ cincuenta dólares.
exercises.explanation: 'El total es de...' is the standard way to state a total amount.

exercises.question: Esto es muy caro; busco algo más _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Barato' means 'cheap/inexpensive' — the opposite of 'caro'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ el café.
exercises.explanation: 'Gustar' agrees with the thing liked, not the person — singular 'el café' takes 'gusta'.

exercises.question: A ti te _____ la música clásica.
exercises.explanation: The singular subject 'la música' takes 'gusta', regardless of who likes it.

exercises.question: A él le _____ el fútbol.
exercises.explanation: 'Le gusta' means 'he/she likes' — 'le' refers to the person, 'gusta' agrees with 'el fútbol'.

exercises.question: A nosotros nos _____ esta ciudad.
exercises.explanation: 'Nos gusta' means 'we like' — 'gusta' agrees with the singular thing liked.

exercises.question: A ellos les _____ el cine.
exercises.explanation: 'Les gusta' means 'they like' (singular thing liked).

exercises.question: ¿Te _____ el chocolate?
exercises.explanation: The question form '¿te gusta...?' asks 'do you like...?' for a singular thing.

exercises.question: A mi hermana le _____ bailar.
exercises.explanation: Infinitives ('bailar') always take the singular form 'gusta', even when listing several activities.

exercises.question: No me _____ el invierno.
exercises.explanation: Negation just adds 'no' before 'me' — 'no me gusta' means 'I don't like'.

exercises.question: A usted le _____ este restaurante, ¿verdad?
exercises.explanation: Formal 'usted' still uses 'le gusta' — the same structure as 'él/ella'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ mucho leer.
exercises.explanation: 'Leer' (to read) is an infinitive, so it takes the singular 'gusta'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ los libros de misterio.
exercises.explanation: Plural things liked ('los libros') require 'gustan', not 'gusta'.

exercises.question: A ella le _____ las flores.
exercises.explanation: 'Las flores' is plural, so the verb must also be plural: 'gustan'.

exercises.question: ¿Te _____ los deportes?
exercises.explanation: 'Los deportes' is plural — the question becomes '¿te gustan...?'.

exercises.question: A nosotros nos _____ las películas de terror.
exercises.explanation: The plural subject 'las películas' takes 'gustan'.

exercises.question: A ellos les _____ los videojuegos.
exercises.explanation: 'Los videojuegos' is plural, so 'gustan' is required.

exercises.question: A mí no me _____ las arañas.
exercises.explanation: 'Las arañas' (spiders) is plural — 'no me gustan' means 'I don't like'.

exercises.question: A ti te _____ mis fotos, ¿no?
exercises.explanation: 'Mis fotos' is plural, so the verb agrees as 'gustan'.

exercises.question: A mi papá le _____ los carros antiguos.
exercises.explanation: 'Los carros' is plural — 'le gustan' agrees with it.

exercises.question: ¿A ustedes les _____ estas canciones?
exercises.explanation: 'Estas canciones' is plural, so 'gustan' is the correct form.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ los animales.
exercises.explanation: 'Los animales' is plural, requiring 'gustan'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ la música en vivo. (love/adore)
exercises.explanation: 'Encantar' works just like 'gustar' — 'me encanta' means 'I love/adore'.

exercises.question: A ella le _____ los viajes. (loves)
exercises.explanation: 'Encantar' agrees with the plural thing loved: 'los viajes' → 'encantan'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ la historia. (interests)
exercises.explanation: 'Interesar' follows the 'gustar' pattern — singular 'la historia' takes 'interesa'.

exercises.question: A nosotros nos _____ los idiomas. (interest us)
exercises.explanation: 'Interesar' agrees with the plural thing that interests: 'los idiomas'.

exercises.question: A él le _____ el ruido. (bothers)
exercises.explanation: 'Molestar' also follows the 'gustar' pattern — singular 'el ruido' takes 'molesta'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ las interrupciones. (bother me)
exercises.explanation: 'Molestar' agrees with the plural thing: 'las interrupciones'.

exercises.question: ¿Te _____ el arte moderno? (interest)
exercises.explanation: 'El arte' is singular, so the question is '¿te interesa...?'.

exercises.question: A nosotros nos _____ mucho esta ciudad. (love it)
exercises.explanation: 'Esta ciudad' is singular, so 'encanta' agrees with it.

exercises.question: A ellos les _____ los mosquitos. (bother them)
exercises.explanation: 'Los mosquitos' is plural, requiring 'molestan'.

exercises.question: A mi mamá le _____ cocinar. (loves)
exercises.explanation: Infinitives like 'cocinar' always take the singular form 'encanta'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ te llamas?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cómo te llamas?' asks 'what is your name?' (literally 'how do you call yourself').

exercises.question: ¿_____ vives?
exercises.explanation: '¿Dónde...?' means 'where...?'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ es tu cumpleaños?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cuándo...?' means 'when...?'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ estudias español?
exercises.explanation: '¿Por qué...?' means 'why...?'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ es esto?
exercises.explanation: '¿Qué...?' means 'what...?'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ es tu profesor?
exercises.explanation: '¿Quién...?' means 'who...?'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ cuesta el boleto?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cuánto...?' means 'how much...?'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ hermanos tienes?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cuántos...?' means 'how many...?' (masculine plural).

exercises.question: ¿_____ es tu color favorito?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cuál...?' means 'which...?' — often used to ask someone to choose, like a favorite.

exercises.question: ¿_____ vas a la fiesta?
exercises.explanation: '¿Cómo vas...?' can ask 'how are you going (getting there)?'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ un libro que me gusta mucho.
exercises.explanation: Review: 'tengo' (I have) — the first-person form of 'tener'.

exercises.question: Ella no _____ venir porque tiene trabajo.
exercises.explanation: Review: 'puede' (she can) — the third-person form of 'poder'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ dos entradas para el concierto.
exercises.explanation: Review: 'tenemos' (we have) — the nosotros-form of 'tener'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú venir a la fiesta?
exercises.explanation: Review: 'puedes' (can you) — the tú-form of 'poder'.

exercises.question: A ellos les _____ mucho el fútbol.
exercises.explanation: Review: the singular 'el fútbol' takes 'gusta'.

exercises.question: A mí _____ nadar, pero hoy no puedo.
exercises.explanation: Review: 'me gusta' (I like) + the infinitive 'nadar'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ ustedes ayudarme, por favor?
exercises.explanation: Review: 'pueden' (can you all) — the ustedes-form of 'poder'.

exercises.question: Mi amiga _____ una casa muy bonita.
exercises.explanation: Review: 'tiene' (she has) — the third-person form of 'tener'.

exercises.question: Nosotros no _____ salir por el clima.
exercises.explanation: Review: 'podemos' (we can) — the nosotros-form of 'poder'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ los fines de semana libres.
exercises.explanation: Review: the plural 'los fines de semana' takes 'gustan'.

exercises.question: Mi hermano es muy _____. (tall)
exercises.explanation: Adjectives agree in gender — 'alto' is the masculine singular form.

exercises.question: Mi hermana es muy _____. (tall)
exercises.explanation: 'Alta' is the feminine form of 'alto'.

exercises.question: El coche es _____. (red)
exercises.explanation: 'Rojo' agrees with 'el coche' (masculine).

exercises.question: La casa es _____. (big)
exercises.explanation: 'Grande' doesn't change for gender — same form for masculine and feminine.

exercises.question: Mi perro es _____. (small)
exercises.explanation: 'Pequeño' agrees with 'el perro' (masculine).

exercises.question: Ella es muy _____. (intelligent)
exercises.explanation: Adjectives ending in '-e' (like 'inteligente') don't change for gender.

exercises.question: El libro es _____. (interesting)
exercises.explanation: 'Interesante' ends in '-e', so it stays the same for masculine and feminine.

exercises.question: Mi amiga es muy _____. (funny)
exercises.explanation: 'Divertida' is the feminine form of 'divertido'.

exercises.question: Los estudiantes son muy _____. (hardworking)
exercises.explanation: 'Trabajadores' is the masculine plural form.

exercises.question: Las chicas son muy _____. (nice)
exercises.explanation: 'Simpáticas' is the feminine plural form.

exercises.question: El programa es interesant_____. (singular)
exercises.explanation: The singular form 'interesante' needs no extra letter.

exercises.question: Los programas son interesant_____. (plural)
exercises.explanation: Adjectives ending in a vowel add '-s' for the plural: 'interesantes'.

exercises.question: La mujer es trabajador_____. (singular)
exercises.explanation: 'Trabajadora' is the singular feminine form.

exercises.question: Las mujeres son trabajador_____. (plural)
exercises.explanation: Add '-s' to the feminine singular form for the plural: 'trabajadoras'.

exercises.question: El examen es _____. (difficult, singular)
exercises.explanation: Adjectives ending in a consonant like 'difícil' don't add anything in the singular.

exercises.question: Los exámenes son _____. (difficult, plural)
exercises.explanation: Adjectives ending in a consonant add '-es' for the plural: 'difíciles'.

exercises.question: El niño es feliz. Los niños son _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Feliz' becomes 'felices' in the plural — the 'z' changes to 'c' before '-es'.

exercises.question: La casa es azul. Las casas son _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Azul' adds '-es' for the plural: 'azules' (same form for masculine and feminine).

exercises.question: El chico es joven. Los chicos son _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Joven' becomes 'jóvenes' in the plural, with an added accent to keep the stress in the same place.

exercises.question: La flor es bonita. Las flores son _____.
exercises.explanation: 'Bonita' becomes 'bonitas' — add '-s' for the feminine plural.

exercises.question: Es un _____ día. (good, shortened)
exercises.explanation: 'Bueno' shortens to 'buen' before a masculine singular noun.

exercises.question: Es un día _____. (good, after the noun)
exercises.explanation: After the noun, the full form 'bueno' is used.

exercises.question: Hace _____ tiempo hoy. (bad, shortened)
exercises.explanation: 'Malo' shortens to 'mal' before a masculine singular noun.

exercises.question: Es un hombre muy _____. (great)
exercises.explanation: 'Grande' shortens to 'gran' before a singular noun (masculine or feminine) and changes meaning to 'great', not 'big'.

exercises.question: Es una ciudad _____. (big, after the noun)
exercises.explanation: 'Grande' after the noun means 'big' in size, not 'great'.

exercises.question: Tengo un _____ amigo. (great friend)
exercises.explanation: 'Gran' before the noun means 'great' (quality), not physical size.

exercises.question: Es una _____ persona. (good, feminine)
exercises.explanation: 'Buena' (feminine) does NOT shorten — only the masculine 'bueno' shortens to 'buen'.

exercises.question: Vivo en una casa _____. (small, after the noun)
exercises.explanation: Most descriptive adjectives, like 'pequeña', go after the noun.

exercises.question: Tiene _____ suerte. (bad luck)
exercises.explanation: 'Suerte' is feminine, so 'mala' is used — feminine adjectives don't shorten.

exercises.question: Es el _____ estudiante de la fila. (third)
exercises.explanation: 'Tercero' shortens to 'tercer' before a masculine singular noun, just like 'primero' → 'primer'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ como pizza los viernes. (always)
exercises.explanation: 'Siempre' means 'always'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ llega tarde. (never)
exercises.explanation: 'Nunca' means 'never'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ vamos al cine. (sometimes)
exercises.explanation: 'A veces' means 'sometimes'.

exercises.question: Él _____ estudia por la noche. (often)
exercises.explanation: 'A menudo' means 'often'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ bebo café. (usually)
exercises.explanation: 'Normalmente' means 'usually/normally'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ salen los domingos. (always)
exercises.explanation: 'Siempre' (always) usually goes right before the conjugated verb.

exercises.question: Tú _____ me ayudas, gracias. (always)
exercises.explanation: Review of 'siempre' — placed right before the verb.

exercises.question: Ella _____ come carne; es vegetariana. (never)
exercises.explanation: 'Nunca' expresses total absence — she never eats meat.

exercises.question: ¿Con qué frecuencia _____ tú al gimnasio?
exercises.explanation: '¿Con qué frecuencia...?' asks 'how often...?' — 'vas' agrees with 'tú'.

exercises.question: _____ tengo tiempo para leer. (rarely)
exercises.explanation: 'Rara vez' means 'rarely/seldom'.

exercises.question: Mi hermano es más alto _____ yo. (than)
exercises.explanation: 'Más + adjetivo + que' means 'more... than' — 'que' introduces the comparison.

exercises.question: Ella es menos alta _____ su hermana. (than)
exercises.explanation: 'Menos + adjetivo + que' means 'less... than'.

exercises.question: Mi casa es tan grande _____ la tuya. (as)
exercises.explanation: 'Tan + adjetivo + como' means 'as... as' — equal comparisons use 'como', not 'que'.

exercises.question: Este libro es _____ interesante que el otro. (more)
exercises.explanation: 'Más' means 'more' — used to form comparisons of superiority.

exercises.question: Esta película es _____ aburrida que la otra. (less)
exercises.explanation: 'Menos' means 'less' — used to form comparisons of inferiority.

exercises.question: Juan es _____ simpático como su padre. (as... as)
exercises.explanation: 'Tan' pairs with 'como' to express equality: 'tan simpático como'.

exercises.question: Mi ciudad es _____ grande que la tuya. (bigger)
exercises.explanation: 'Más grande que' means 'bigger than'.

exercises.question: Soy _____ joven que mi hermano. (younger)
exercises.explanation: 'Más joven que' means 'younger than'.

exercises.question: Este ejercicio es _____ difícil que el anterior. (harder)
exercises.explanation: 'Más difícil que' means 'harder/more difficult than'.

exercises.question: Ella corre _____ rápido como un atleta profesional. (as fast as)
exercises.explanation: 'Tan rápido como' means 'as fast as' — equal comparison.

exercises.question: Ayer yo _____ a Madrid. (travel)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar preterite: the yo-form ends in -é — 'viajé'.

exercises.question: Tú _____ la maleta anoche. (pack)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar preterite: the tú-form ends in -aste — 'empacaste'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ el vuelo a tiempo. (catch)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar preterite: the third-person form ends in -ó — 'tomó'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ en un hotel bonito. (stay)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar preterite: the nosotros-form ends in -amos — 'nos alojamos'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ muchas fotos. (take)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar preterite: the third-person plural ends in -aron — 'tomaron'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ la cuenta del hotel. (pay)
exercises.explanation: 'Pagar' has a spelling change in the yo-form: g→gu before -é, giving 'pagué'.

exercises.question: Tú _____ en un restaurante local. (eat)
exercises.explanation: Regular -er preterite: the tú-form ends in -iste — 'comiste'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ la puerta de su cuarto. (open)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ir preterite: the third-person form ends in -ió — 'abrió'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ el mapa de la ciudad. (receive)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ir preterite: the nosotros-form ends in -imos — 'recibimos'.

exercises.question: El tren _____ a las ocho. (leave)
exercises.explanation: 'Salir' is regular in the preterite — the third-person singular is 'salió'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ a España el año pasado. (go)
exercises.explanation: 'Ir' is irregular in the preterite — the yo-form is 'fui' (identical to 'ser').

exercises.question: El viaje _____ increíble. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Ser' is irregular — the third-person preterite is 'fue' (identical to 'ir').

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ mucho miedo en el avión. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Tener' is irregular in the preterite — the nosotros-form is 'tuvimos'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ en el aeropuerto por tres horas. (be/stay)
exercises.explanation: 'Estar' is irregular — the third-person plural preterite is 'estuvieron'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú las maletas antes de salir? (do/make)
exercises.explanation: 'Hacer' is irregular — the tú-form preterite is 'hiciste'.

exercises.question: Yo no _____ nada interesante en el museo. (see)
exercises.explanation: 'Ver' is irregular — the yo-form preterite is 'vi' (no accent, unlike regular verbs).

exercises.question: Ella _____ correr para no perder el vuelo. (have to)
exercises.explanation: 'Tener que' + infinitive — the third-person preterite of 'tener' is 'tuvo'.

exercises.question: ¿Qué _____ ustedes en sus vacaciones? (do)
exercises.explanation: 'Hacer' — the third-person plural preterite is 'hicieron'.

exercises.question: Yo le _____ a mi amigo que el hotel era hermoso. (say/tell)
exercises.explanation: 'Decir' is irregular — the yo-form preterite is 'dije'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ al guía por la ciudad. (follow)
exercises.explanation: 'Seguir' — the nosotros-form preterite looks regular: 'seguimos'.

exercises.question: _____ dos años que viajé a Perú. (ago)
exercises.explanation: 'Hace + time' means '... ago' — 'hace dos años' = 'two years ago'.

exercises.question: Fui a Chile _____ un mes.
exercises.explanation: 'Hace un mes' means 'a month ago'.

exercises.question: _____ mucho tiempo que no viajo.
exercises.explanation: 'Hace mucho tiempo que no...' means 'it's been a long time since I haven't...'.

exercises.question: Llegamos al hotel _____ una hora.
exercises.explanation: 'Hace una hora' means 'an hour ago'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ cuánto tiempo viajaste a Brasil?
exercises.explanation: '¿Hace cuánto...?' asks 'how long ago...?'.

exercises.question: Compré el boleto _____ tres días.
exercises.explanation: 'Hace tres días' means 'three days ago'.

exercises.question: _____ una semana que estoy de vacaciones.
exercises.explanation: 'Hace + time + que + present tense' expresses an action that started in the past and continues: 'I've been on vacation for a week'.

exercises.question: Visité ese museo _____ mucho tiempo.
exercises.explanation: 'Hace mucho tiempo' means 'a long time ago'.

exercises.question: _____ dos días llegamos a la playa.
exercises.explanation: 'Hace dos días' means 'two days ago' — placed at the start of the sentence here.

exercises.question: Salimos del hotel _____ media hora.
exercises.explanation: 'Hace media hora' means 'half an hour ago'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ viajar a Colombia el próximo mes. (going to)
exercises.explanation: 'Ir a + infinitivo' expresses the near future — the yo-form is 'voy a'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ visitar a su familia en Perú.
exercises.explanation: 'Va a' is the third-person form of this near-future construction.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ reservar el hotel mañana.
exercises.explanation: 'Vamos a' is the nosotros-form.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú a viajar solo o con amigos?
exercises.explanation: '¿Vas a...?' asks 'are you going to...?'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ quedarse en un hostal barato.
exercises.explanation: 'Van a' is the third-person plural form.

exercises.question: ¿Qué _____ hacer ustedes en la playa?
exercises.explanation: With 'ustedes', use 'van a'.

exercises.question: Yo no _____ olvidar este viaje nunca.
exercises.explanation: Negation goes before 'voy a', not inside the construction.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ llegar temprano al aeropuerto.
exercises.explanation: 'Vamos a llegar' means 'we are going to arrive'.

exercises.question: Mi amiga _____ acompañarme en el viaje.
exercises.explanation: Third-person singular: 'va a acompañarme'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ ustedes a comprar los boletos hoy?
exercises.explanation: '¿Van a...?' asks 'are you (plural) going to...?'.

exercises.question: ¿Tienes el pasaporte? Sí, _____ tengo.
exercises.explanation: 'Lo' replaces a masculine singular direct object — 'el pasaporte'.

exercises.question: ¿Compraste la maleta? Sí, _____ compré.
exercises.explanation: 'La' replaces a feminine singular direct object — 'la maleta'.

exercises.question: ¿Viste los boletos? Sí, _____ vi.
exercises.explanation: 'Los' replaces a masculine plural direct object — 'los boletos'.

exercises.question: ¿Trajiste las llaves? Sí, _____ traje.
exercises.explanation: 'Las' replaces a feminine plural direct object — 'las llaves'.

exercises.question: No _____ encuentro. (mi pasaporte)

exercises.question: ¿Conoces a mi amiga? Sí, _____ conozco.

exercises.question: Voy a comprar_____. (el boleto)

exercises.question: ¿Necesitas ayuda? _____ necesito, gracias.

exercises.question: ¿Dónde están mis gafas de sol? No _____ veo.

exercises.question: Ya _____ reservé, el hotel está confirmado.
exercises.explanation: 'El hotel' is masculine singular, so 'lo reservé' is correct.

exercises.question: Antes yo _____ en una oficina. (work)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar imperfect: the yo-form ends in -aba — 'trabajaba'.

exercises.question: Tú _____ mucho cuando eras joven. (study)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar imperfect: the tú-form ends in -abas — 'estudiabas'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ en una fábrica. (work)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar imperfect: the third-person form ends in -aba — 'trabajaba'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ juntos todos los días. (work)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar imperfect: the nosotros-form ends in -ábamos — 'trabajábamos'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ para la misma empresa. (work)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar imperfect: the third-person plural ends in -aban — 'trabajaban'.

exercises.explanation: Regular -ir imperfect: the nosotros-form ends in -íamos — 'escribíamos'.

exercises.question: Mi jefe _____ muy estricto. (seem)
exercises.explanation: Regular -er imperfect: the third-person form ends in -ía — 'parecía'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ reuniones cada semana. (need)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar imperfect: the third-person plural ends in -aban — 'necesitaban'.

exercises.explanation: 'Ser' imperfect — the nosotros-form is 'éramos'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ al trabajo en autobús. (go)
exercises.explanation: 'Ir' is irregular in the imperfect — the third-person plural is 'iban'.

exercises.explanation: 'Ser' imperfect — the third-person singular is 'era'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú feliz en tu antiguo trabajo? (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Ser' imperfect — the tú-form is 'eras'.

exercises.explanation: 'Ir' imperfect — the third-person singular is 'iba'.

exercises.explanation: 'Ser' imperfect — the nosotros-form is 'éramos'.

exercises.explanation: An interrupting, completed action uses the preterite — 'sonó' (it rang).

exercises.question: Yo _____ en esa empresa por diez años. (work)

exercises.question: Antes, ella siempre _____ tarde a las reuniones. (arrive)
exercises.explanation: Habitual or repeated past actions use the imperfect — 'llegaba' (she used to arrive).

exercises.question: Mientras yo _____ el informe, mi colega me interrumpió. (write)
exercises.explanation: The ongoing background action uses the imperfect — 'escribía' (I was writing).

exercises.explanation: A specific, completed event in the past uses the preterite form of 'haber': 'hubo'.

exercises.question: De niño, yo _____ que quería ser doctor. (think)
exercises.explanation: Descriptions of past states of mind use the imperfect — 'pensaba'.

exercises.question: El lunes pasado, mi jefe _____ un anuncio importante. (make)
exercises.explanation: A specific one-time action on a specific day uses the preterite — 'hizo'.

exercises.question: Cuando yo era joven, _____ menos responsabilidades. (have)
exercises.explanation: Background description of a past state uses the imperfect — 'tenía'.

exercises.question: El proyecto _____ exitoso al final. (be)
exercises.explanation: A completed outcome/result uses the preterite — 'fue'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ terminar este informe hoy. (must)

exercises.question: Tú _____ llegar a tiempo a las reuniones. (must)
exercises.explanation: 'Deber' — the tú-form is 'debes'.

exercises.explanation: 'Tener que' + infinitive — the nosotros-form is 'tenemos que'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ que revisar el contrato antes de firmarlo. (have to)
exercises.explanation: 'Tener que' — the third-person singular is 'tiene que'.

exercises.question: Ustedes _____ seguir las reglas de la empresa. (must)
exercises.explanation: 'Deber' — the third-person plural is 'deben'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ yo hablar con el jefe sobre esto? (should)
exercises.explanation: '¿Debo...?' asks 'should I...?'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ que entregar el reporte antes del viernes. (have to)
exercises.explanation: 'Tener que' — the third-person plural is 'tienen que'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ ser puntuales siempre. (must)
exercises.explanation: 'Deber' — the nosotros-form is 'debemos'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ que llamar al cliente urgentemente. (have to)
exercises.explanation: 'Tener que' — the yo-form is 'tengo que'.

exercises.question: Tú no _____ trabajar los fines de semana. (should not)
exercises.explanation: Negative obligation: 'no debes' means 'you shouldn't'.

exercises.explanation: 'Le' is the indirect object pronoun for 'a mi jefe' (to him).

exercises.explanation: 'Les' is the indirect object pronoun for a plural 'a los clientes' (to them).

exercises.question: Mi jefe _____ explicó el proyecto a mí. (to me)
exercises.explanation: 'Me' is the indirect object pronoun for 'a mí' (to me).

exercises.explanation: 'Me' means 'to me' — used to ask someone to send you something.

exercises.explanation: 'Les' refers to 'al equipo' (to them, the team).

exercises.question: ¿Qué _____ dijiste a tu jefe? (to him/her)
exercises.explanation: 'Le' is used for singular indirect objects, whether male or female.

exercises.question: Mi colega _____ prestó su computadora a mí. (to me)
exercises.explanation: 'Me' — 'my colleague lent his computer to me'.

exercises.question: El jefe _____ ofreció un ascenso a ella. (to her)
exercises.explanation: 'Le' is used here for 'a ella' (to her) — the same form as 'to him'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ mandamos el informe a ustedes. (to you all)
exercises.explanation: 'Les' refers to 'a ustedes' (to you all).

exercises.question: ¿_____ puedo hacer una pregunta? (to you, informal)
exercises.explanation: 'Te' means 'to you' (informal) — asking permission to ask someone a question.

exercises.question: _____ agua todos los días. (drink)
exercises.explanation: Regular -er tú imperative drops the -s from the present tense: 'bebe'.

exercises.question: _____ más verduras. (eat)
exercises.explanation: Regular -er tú imperative: 'come' (drop the final -s from 'comes').

exercises.question: _____ temprano esta noche. (sleep)
exercises.explanation: 'Dormir' stem-changes (o→ue) even in the imperative: 'duerme'.

exercises.question: _____ al médico si te sientes mal. (go)
exercises.explanation: 'Ir' has an irregular tú imperative: 've' (not 'vas').

exercises.question: _____ la medicina con comida. (take)
exercises.explanation: Regular -ar tú imperative: 'toma' (drop the final -s).

exercises.question: _____ paciencia, te vas a mejorar pronto. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Tener' has an irregular tú imperative: 'ten'.

exercises.question: _____ ejercicio regularmente. (do)
exercises.explanation: 'Hacer' has an irregular tú imperative: 'haz'.

exercises.question: _____ bien esta noche. (rest)
exercises.explanation: Reflexive tú imperative attaches '-te': 'descánsate'.

exercises.question: _____ cuidado con lo que comes. (be careful)
exercises.explanation: 'Ten cuidado' means 'be careful' — irregular imperative of 'tener'.

exercises.question: _____ me si necesitas algo. (tell)
exercises.explanation: 'Decir' has an irregular tú imperative: 'di'.

exercises.question: No _____ tanta azúcar. (eat)
exercises.explanation: Negative tú imperative uses the present subjunctive: 'no comas'.

exercises.question: No _____ tan tarde. (sleep)
exercises.explanation: Negative imperative: 'no duermas' (present subjunctive of 'dormir').

exercises.explanation: Negative imperative of 'ir' is irregular: 'no vayas' (not 'no ve').

exercises.explanation: Negative tú imperative: 'no tomes' (present subjunctive of 'tomar').

exercises.explanation: Negative imperative of 'tener' is irregular: 'no tengas'.

exercises.question: No _____ ejercicio si te duele la espalda. (do)
exercises.explanation: Negative imperative of 'hacer' is irregular: 'no hagas'.

exercises.question: No _____ tan rápido, vas a lastimarte. (run)
exercises.explanation: Negative tú imperative: 'no corras' (present subjunctive of 'correr').

exercises.question: No _____ nervioso, todo va a estar bien. (be)
exercises.explanation: Negative imperative of 'estar' is irregular: 'no estés'.

exercises.question: No _____ el tratamiento a la mitad. (leave)
exercises.explanation: Negative tú imperative: 'no dejes' (present subjunctive of 'dejar').

exercises.question: No _____ miedo, la inyección no duele mucho. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'No tengas miedo' means 'don't be afraid' — irregular negative imperative of 'tener'.

exercises.explanation: 'Doler' works like 'gustar' — singular 'la cabeza' takes 'duele'.

exercises.explanation: Plural 'los pies' requires 'duelen'.

exercises.explanation: 'La garganta' is singular, so the question is '¿te duele...?'.

exercises.explanation: Plural 'las piernas' requires 'duelen'.

exercises.explanation: Singular 'el estómago' takes 'duele'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ mucho los ojos.
exercises.explanation: Plural 'los ojos' requires 'duelen'.

exercises.question: A ustedes les _____ la espalda, ¿verdad?
exercises.explanation: Singular 'la espalda' takes 'duele'.

exercises.explanation: Plural 'las rodillas' requires 'duelen'.

exercises.question: A ti te _____ el brazo desde el accidente.
exercises.explanation: Singular 'el brazo' takes 'duele'.

exercises.question: A mí me _____ los dientes cuando como algo frío.
exercises.explanation: Plural 'los dientes' requires 'duelen'.

exercises.question: Este medicamento es _____ el dolor de cabeza. (for)
exercises.explanation: 'Para' expresses purpose — 'para el dolor' means 'for the pain'.

exercises.question: Caminé _____ el parque para hacer ejercicio. (through)
exercises.explanation: 'Por' expresses movement through a place — 'por el parque'.

exercises.question: Voy al médico _____ la mañana. (in)
exercises.explanation: 'Por la mañana' means 'in the morning' — a fixed expression.

exercises.question: Tomo esta pastilla _____ dormir mejor. (in order to)
exercises.explanation: 'Para + infinitivo' expresses purpose — 'to sleep better'.

exercises.question: Fui al hospital _____ un fuerte dolor de estómago. (because of)
exercises.explanation: 'Por' expresses cause/reason — 'because of a strong stomach ache'.

exercises.question: Este jarabe es bueno _____ la tos. (for)
exercises.explanation: 'Para la tos' means 'for the cough' — purpose.

exercises.question: Necesito la receta _____ mañana. (by)
exercises.explanation: 'Para mañana' means 'by tomorrow' — a deadline.

exercises.question: El doctor me llamó _____ teléfono. (by)
exercises.explanation: 'Por teléfono' means 'by phone' — means of communication.

exercises.question: Gracias _____ tu ayuda con mi recuperación. (for)
exercises.explanation: 'Gracias por' means 'thanks for' — 'por' after 'gracias' is fixed.

exercises.question: Este consejo es _____ ti, cuídate mucho. (for)
exercises.explanation: 'Para ti' means 'for you' — indicating the recipient.

exercises.explanation: 'Se recomienda' means 'it is recommended' — impersonal 'se'.

exercises.explanation: '¿Cómo se dice...?' is the standard way to ask 'how do you say...?'.

exercises.explanation: 'Se puede' means 'one can' — impersonal 'se'.

exercises.explanation: Regular future: add '-ás' to the infinitive — 'empezarás'.

exercises.explanation: Regular future: the third-person adds '-á' — 'creará'.

exercises.explanation: Regular future: the nosotros-form adds '-emos' — 'usaremos'.

exercises.explanation: 'Salir' has an irregular future stem 'saldr-' — 'saldrá'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ publicado la noticia. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Haber' — the third-person plural is 'han': 'han publicado'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú comentado la noticia en redes sociales? (have)
exercises.explanation: Question form: '¿has comentado?' (have you commented?).

exercises.question: Yo no _____ terminado de leer el periódico. (have)
exercises.explanation: Negative present perfect: 'no he terminado'.

exercises.question: El canal _____ transmitido la noticia en vivo. (has)
exercises.explanation: Third-person singular 'ha' for 'el canal' (the channel).

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ compartido el video con amigos. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Hemos compartido' means 'we have shared'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ ustedes visto el nuevo documental? (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Ustedes' takes the third-person plural form 'han'.

exercises.question: Yo he _____ un artículo interesante. (write)
exercises.explanation: 'Escribir' has an irregular participle: 'escrito' (not 'escribido').

exercises.question: Ella ha _____ muchas noticias falsas. (see)
exercises.explanation: 'Ver' has an irregular participle: 'visto'.

exercises.question: Nosotros hemos _____ el reportaje completo. (do/make)
exercises.explanation: 'Hacer' has an irregular participle: 'hecho'.

exercises.question: ¿Qué han _____ los periodistas sobre esto? (say)
exercises.explanation: 'Decir' has an irregular participle: 'dicho'.

exercises.question: El canal ha _____ la transmisión en vivo. (open)
exercises.explanation: 'Abrir' has an irregular participle: 'abierto'.

exercises.question: Yo he _____ mi opinión en la radio. (put/express)
exercises.explanation: 'Poner' has an irregular participle: 'puesto'.

exercises.question: Ese periódico ha _____ récords esta semana. (break)
exercises.explanation: 'Romper' has an irregular participle: 'roto'.

exercises.question: Ellos han _____ a hablar de ese tema otra vez. (return)
exercises.explanation: 'Volver' has an irregular participle: 'vuelto'.

exercises.question: El escándalo ha _____ toda la prensa. (cover)
exercises.explanation: 'Cubrir' has an irregular participle: 'cubierto'.

exercises.question: Nunca he _____ una noticia tan triste. (see)
exercises.explanation: Review: 'ver' → 'visto' (irregular participle).

exercises.question: Yo _____ viendo las noticias ahora mismo. (am watching)
exercises.explanation: Present progressive: 'estar' (estoy) + gerund — 'estoy viendo'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ leyendo un artículo. (is reading)
exercises.explanation: 'Está leyendo' means 'she is reading'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ escuchando un podcast interesante. (are listening)
exercises.explanation: 'Estamos escuchando' means 'we are listening'.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ transmitiendo el partido en vivo. (are broadcasting)
exercises.explanation: 'Están transmitiendo' means 'they are broadcasting'.

exercises.question: ¿Qué _____ diciendo el presentador? (is saying)
exercises.explanation: '¿Qué está diciendo?' asks 'what is he saying?'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ escribiendo un comentario sobre la noticia. (am writing)
exercises.explanation: 'Estoy escribiendo' means 'I am writing'.

exercises.question: Tú _____ compartiendo demasiadas noticias falsas. (are sharing)
exercises.explanation: 'Estás compartiendo' means 'you are sharing'.

exercises.question: El canal _____ cubriendo el evento en directo. (is covering)
exercises.explanation: 'Está cubriendo' means 'is covering'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ siguiendo esa noticia de cerca. (are following)
exercises.explanation: 'Estamos siguiendo' means 'we are following'.

exercises.question: Muchas personas _____ hablando de este tema hoy. (are talking)
exercises.explanation: 'Están hablando' means 'are talking'.

exercises.question: Es importante que tú _____ las noticias con cuidado. (read)
exercises.explanation: 'Es importante que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que tú leas'.

exercises.question: Es necesario que nosotros _____ la información antes de compartirla. (verify)
exercises.explanation: 'Es necesario que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que nosotros verifiquemos'.

exercises.question: Es bueno que la gente _____ escéptica con las noticias. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Ser' subjunctive — the third-person form is 'sea'.

exercises.question: Es importante que los periodistas _____ la verdad. (say)
exercises.explanation: 'Decir' subjunctive — the third-person plural is 'digan'.

exercises.question: Es mejor que tú _____ dos fuentes antes de creer algo. (check)
exercises.explanation: 'Es mejor que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que tú revises'.

exercises.question: Es raro que ese canal no _____ sobre esto. (report)
exercises.explanation: 'Es raro que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que informe'.

exercises.question: Es probable que la noticia _____ falsa. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Es probable que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que sea'.

exercises.question: Es importante que nosotros _____ atención a las fuentes. (pay)
exercises.explanation: 'Es importante que' + the nosotros-form subjunctive: 'prestemos'.

exercises.question: Es necesario que ustedes _____ más cuidadosos con lo que comparten. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Ser' subjunctive — the third-person plural is 'sean'.

exercises.question: Es bueno que tú _____ diferentes puntos de vista. (know)
exercises.explanation: 'Es bueno que' + the tú-form subjunctive: 'conozcas'.

exercises.question: El periodista _____ que la situación es grave. (says)
exercises.explanation: 'Dice que' means 'he/she says that' — reporting what someone said.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ que van a cambiar la ley. (say)
exercises.explanation: 'Dicen que' means 'they say that'.

exercises.question: Mi amigo me _____ que vio la noticia ayer. (told)
exercises.explanation: 'Me dijo que' means 'he/she told me that' — past tense of 'decir'.

exercises.question: El reportero _____ que habrá más información pronto. (said)
exercises.explanation: 'Dijo que' means 'he/she said that'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ que esa fuente no es confiable. (say)
exercises.explanation: 'Digo que' means 'I say that'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ que el artículo tiene errores. (says)
exercises.explanation: 'Dice que' means 'she says that'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ que la noticia es importante. (say)
exercises.explanation: 'Decimos que' means 'we say that'.

exercises.question: Los expertos _____ que la situación va a mejorar. (say)
exercises.explanation: 'Dicen que' means 'they (the experts) say that'.

exercises.question: ¿Qué _____ el artículo sobre este tema? (does say)
exercises.explanation: '¿Qué dice el artículo?' asks 'what does the article say?'.

exercises.question: Tú siempre _____ que las noticias te aburren. (say)
exercises.explanation: 'Dices que' means 'you say that'.

exercises.question: Yo quiero que tú _____ conmigo a estudiar en el extranjero. (come)
exercises.explanation: 'Querer que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que tú vengas'.

exercises.question: Ojalá _____ buen clima para el viaje. (there is)
exercises.explanation: 'Ojalá' always triggers the subjunctive — 'ojalá haya' (I hope there is).

exercises.question: Mis padres quieren que yo _____ una carrera universitaria. (study)
exercises.explanation: 'Quieren que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que yo estudie'.

exercises.question: Ojalá _____ conseguir el trabajo de mis sueños. (I can)
exercises.explanation: 'Ojalá' + subjunctive — 'ojalá pueda' (I hope I can).

exercises.question: Queremos que ustedes _____ felices en su nueva casa. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Queremos que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que ustedes sean'.

exercises.question: Ojalá _____ más tiempo libre el próximo año. (I have)
exercises.explanation: 'Ojalá tenga' means 'I hope I have' — subjunctive of 'tener'.

exercises.question: Mi jefe quiere que nosotros _____ el proyecto para el viernes. (finish)
exercises.explanation: 'Quiere que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que nosotros terminemos'.

exercises.question: Ojalá ella _____ pronto a casa. (returns)
exercises.explanation: 'Ojalá' + subjunctive of 'volver' — 'vuelva'.

exercises.question: Yo quiero que mis hijos _____ un buen futuro. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Quiero que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que mis hijos tengan'.

exercises.question: Ojalá _____ posible cambiar de trabajo pronto. (it is)
exercises.explanation: 'Ojalá sea posible' means 'I hope it's possible' — subjunctive of 'ser'.

exercises.question: Cuando yo _____ a la universidad, voy a estudiar medicina. (go)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando' + a future action requires the subjunctive: 'cuando vaya' (when I go).

exercises.question: Te llamaré cuando _____ a casa. (arrive)
exercises.explanation: Future 'cuando' clause: 'cuando llegue' (when I arrive).

exercises.question: Cuando tú _____ más grande, entenderás mejor. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando seas' (when you are/become) — subjunctive for future time.

exercises.question: Vamos a viajar cuando _____ suficiente dinero. (we have)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando tengamos' (when we have) — subjunctive for a future condition.

exercises.question: Cuando ellos _____ el examen, celebrarán. (finish)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando terminen' (when they finish) — subjunctive for future time.

exercises.question: Ella se mudará cuando _____ un mejor trabajo. (find)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando encuentre' (when she finds) — subjunctive for future time.

exercises.question: Cuando yo _____ tiempo, voy a visitarte. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando tenga' (when I have) — subjunctive for future time.

exercises.question: Nosotros iremos de vacaciones cuando _____ el verano. (arrives)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando llegue el verano' (when summer comes) — subjunctive.

exercises.question: Cuando ustedes _____ listos, empezaremos la reunión. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando estén listos' (when you're ready) — subjunctive.

exercises.question: Te avisaré cuando _____ noticias. (there are)
exercises.explanation: 'Cuando haya noticias' (when there is news) — subjunctive.

exercises.question: Yo _____ estudiar en el extranjero el próximo año. (am going to)
exercises.explanation: 'Ir a + infinitivo' expresses a decided plan — 'voy a estudiar'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ mudarnos a otra ciudad. (are thinking of)
exercises.explanation: 'Pensar + infinitivo' expresses a plan you're considering — 'pensamos mudarnos'.

exercises.question: Ella _____ cambiar de carrera, pero no está segura. (is thinking of)
exercises.explanation: 'Piensa + infinitivo' suggests a tentative plan, not yet fully decided.

exercises.question: ¿Qué _____ tú hacer después de graduarte? (are you going to)
exercises.explanation: '¿Qué vas a hacer?' asks about a concrete plan.

exercises.question: Ellos _____ abrir su propio negocio algún día. (are thinking of)
exercises.explanation: 'Piensan + infinitivo' — a plan they're considering for the future, less definite.

exercises.question: Yo _____ comprar una casa este año. (am going to)
exercises.explanation: 'Voy a comprar' — a firm, decided plan.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ viajar por Sudamérica algún día. (are thinking of)
exercises.explanation: 'Pensamos + infinitivo' — a future idea, not fully confirmed.

exercises.question: Mi hermano _____ estudiar ingeniería. (is going to)
exercises.explanation: 'Va a estudiar' — a decided plan.

exercises.question: ¿_____ ustedes casarse pronto? (are you thinking of)
exercises.explanation: '¿Piensan casarse?' asks if it's something they're considering.

exercises.question: Yo _____ dejar mi trabajo actual. (am thinking of)
exercises.explanation: 'Pienso + infinitivo' — considering an option, less certain than 'voy a'.

exercises.question: Me _____ trabajar en otro país algún día. (I would like)
exercises.explanation: 'Me gustaría' means 'I would like' — a polite way to express a wish.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú ayudarme a planear mi futuro? (Could you)
exercises.explanation: '¿Podrías...?' is a polite conditional way to ask for help.

exercises.question: _____ pensar en un plan B, por si acaso. (You should)
exercises.explanation: 'Deberías' is the conditional form of 'deber' — a softer suggestion than 'debes'.

exercises.question: Nos _____ mucho conocer tus planes. (We would like)
exercises.explanation: 'Nos gustaría' means 'we would like' — a polite conditional.

exercises.question: ¿_____ ustedes considerar otras opciones? (Could you)
exercises.explanation: '¿Podrían...?' is the polite conditional form for 'ustedes'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ un plan más claro antes de decidir. (would prefer)
exercises.explanation: 'Preferiría' is the conditional of 'preferir' — a polite way to express preference.

exercises.question: _____ hablar con un consejero antes de elegir carrera. (You should)
exercises.explanation: Conditional 'deberías' softens advice, making it sound like a friendly suggestion.

exercises.question: Me _____ saber más sobre tus planes para el futuro. (I would like)
exercises.explanation: 'Me gustaría saber' means 'I would like to know'.

exercises.question: ¿_____ tú considerar estudiar en otro país? (Would you)
exercises.explanation: '¿Podrías considerar...?' politely asks if something is possible.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ empezar con un plan simple. (would prefer)
exercises.explanation: 'Preferiríamos' is the conditional nosotros-form of 'preferir'.

exercises.question: El año pasado yo _____ a México. (go, preterite)
exercises.explanation: Review: a completed past trip uses the preterite — 'fui'.

exercises.question: Antes yo _____ en una fábrica. (work, imperfect)
exercises.explanation: Review: a habitual past action uses the imperfect — 'trabajaba'.

exercises.question: _____ descansar más. (rest, tú imperative)
exercises.explanation: Review: affirmative tú imperative — 'descansa'.

exercises.question: El próximo año yo _____ a otra ciudad. (move, future)
exercises.explanation: Review: a future plan uses the future tense — 'me mudaré'.

exercises.question: Me _____ viajar más este año. (would like, conditional)
exercises.explanation: Review: 'me gustaría' expresses a polite wish.

exercises.question: Es importante que tú _____ tus metas claras. (have, subjunctive)
exercises.explanation: Review: 'es importante que' triggers the subjunctive — 'tengas'.

exercises.question: Cuando yo _____ más experiencia, buscaré un mejor trabajo. (have, subjunctive)
exercises.explanation: Review: 'cuando' + a future action requires the subjunctive — 'tenga'.

exercises.question: Yo _____ visto muchas oportunidades este año. (present perfect, ver)
exercises.explanation: Review: present perfect — 'he visto'.

exercises.question: Ojalá _____ un buen año para todos. (be, subjunctive)
exercises.explanation: Review: 'ojalá' + subjunctive — 'sea'.

exercises.question: Nosotros _____ que hacer un plan claro. (have to, tener que)
exercises.explanation: Review: 'tener que' — the nosotros-form is 'tenemos que'.

exercises.question: Mis padres querían que yo _____ una profesión estable. (study)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive -ar verbs: add '-ara' to the stem — 'estudiara'.

exercises.question: Ella dudaba que nosotros _____ a tiempo. (arrive)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive: the nosotros-form adds '-áramos' — 'llegáramos'.

exercises.question: Si tú _____ más despacio, entenderías mejor. (speak)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive: the tú-form adds '-aras' — 'hablaras'.

exercises.question: Esperábamos que ellos _____ el proyecto a tiempo. (finish)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive: the third-person plural adds '-aran' — 'terminaran'.

exercises.question: Era importante que nosotros _____ juntos. (live)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive -ir verbs: the nosotros-form adds '-iéramos' — 'viviéramos'.

exercises.question: Ojalá yo _____ más sobre ese tema en ese momento. (learn)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive -er verbs: add '-iera' — 'aprendiera'.

exercises.question: El profesor sugirió que los estudiantes _____ más. (read)
exercises.explanation: 'Leer' → imperfect subjunctive 'leyeran' (spelling change y between vowels).

exercises.question: Me pidieron que _____ el documento. (sign)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive: the yo-form adds '-ara' — 'firmara'.

exercises.question: No creían que tú les _____ la verdad. (tell)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive: the tú-form adds '-aras' — 'contaras'.

exercises.question: Queríamos que ella nos _____ su opinión. (explain)
exercises.explanation: Imperfect subjunctive: the third-person adds '-ara' — 'explicara'.

exercises.question: Si yo _____ rico, viajaría por el mundo. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Ser' imperfect subjunctive is 'fuera' (identical to 'ir').

exercises.question: Ojalá _____ más tiempo ayer. (I had)
exercises.explanation: 'Tener' has an irregular imperfect subjunctive stem: 'tuviera'.

exercises.question: Era necesario que nosotros _____ presentes. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Estar' imperfect subjunctive: the nosotros-form is 'estuviéramos'.

exercises.question: Si tú _____ eso, me habría gustado saberlo. (do)
exercises.explanation: 'Hacer' has an irregular imperfect subjunctive stem: 'hicieras'.

exercises.question: Dudaba que ellos _____ resolver el problema. (be able to)
exercises.explanation: 'Poder' has an irregular imperfect subjunctive stem: 'pudieran'.

exercises.question: Ella quería que yo _____ con ella al evento. (go)
exercises.explanation: 'Ir' imperfect subjunctive is 'fuera' (identical to 'ser').

exercises.question: Si nosotros _____ más, ganaríamos el proyecto. (want)
exercises.explanation: 'Querer' has an irregular imperfect subjunctive stem: 'quisiéramos'.

exercises.question: Me sorprendió que ustedes _____ tan rápido. (come)
exercises.explanation: 'Venir' has an irregular imperfect subjunctive stem: 'vinieran'.

exercises.question: Si yo _____ eso antes, habría actuado diferente. (know)
exercises.explanation: 'Saber' has an irregular imperfect subjunctive stem: 'supiera'.

exercises.question: No pensaba que tú _____ capaz de hacerlo. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Ser' imperfect subjunctive — the tú-form is 'fueras'.

exercises.question: Dudo que esa política _____ efectiva. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Dudar que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que sea'.

exercises.question: No creo que el gobierno _____ la solución correcta. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'No creer que' expresses doubt, triggering the subjunctive — 'tenga'.

exercises.question: Ella niega que _____ un problema social grave. (there is)
exercises.explanation: 'Negar que' triggers the subjunctive — 'que haya'.

exercises.question: Dudamos que ellos _____ de acuerdo. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'Dudamos que' — the subjunctive of 'estar' is 'estén'.

exercises.question: No es cierto que la sociedad _____ cambiando tan rápido. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'No es cierto que' expresses doubt, triggering the subjunctive.

exercises.question: Niego que _____ dicho eso. (I have)
exercises.explanation: 'Niego que haya dicho' — present perfect subjunctive with 'haya'.

exercises.question: Dudo que tú _____ razón esta vez. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Dudo que' triggers the subjunctive — 'tengas'.

exercises.question: No creemos que esa ley _____ justa. (be)
exercises.explanation: 'No creemos que' — the subjunctive of 'ser' is 'sea'.

exercises.question: Es dudoso que la reforma _____ pronto. (happen)
exercises.explanation: 'Es dudoso que' triggers the subjunctive — 'ocurra'.

exercises.question: Ellos dudan que nosotros _____ la razón. (have)
exercises.explanation: 'Dudan que' — the subjunctive nosotros-form is 'tengamos'.

exercises.question: Cuando llegué, la reunión ya _____ empezado. (had)
exercises.explanation: Pluperfect: 'había' + participle — 'había empezado' (had already started).

exercises.question: Nosotros ya _____ salido cuando empezó a llover. (had)
exercises.explanation: Pluperfect: the nosotros-form is 'habíamos' — 'habíamos salido'.

exercises.question: Ella dijo que _____ terminado el proyecto antes. (had)
